parameters.name: hostname

aggregated-ether-options link-speed 1g.explanation: Configure the speed of the chain of convergence with the ethnet interface.

aggregated-ether-options lacp active.explanation: Configure the LACP option for the aggregate interface as the active mode.

parameters.name: lacp-mode
parameters.explanation: LACP model, activity indicates a proactive model.

parameters.name: aggregated-interface
parameters.explanation: Name of chain aggregate group, e.g. ae1.

parameters.name: disable
parameters.explanation: Disables the interface, false means enabled.
